raw_text: Completed excavation and subgrade preparation for Crude Column C-101 foundation today as per activity CIV-001.
PCC blinding layer pouring for Column C-101 base slab completed successfully under CIV-002. Inspection passed.
Structural steel crew completed Pipe Rack PR-101 steel column erection Grid A1 to A5 for activity STR-028.
Piping team completed erection of Process Overhead Line Piping Spool 24-CDU-001 on PR-101 (PIP-081).
Heavy lift team achieved vertical alignment for Crude Column C-101 vessel erection under activity MEC-055.
Mechanical team completed Crude Charge Pump P-101A skid placement on foundation F-102 (MEC-055).
Civil gang finished rebar cage tying and steel shuttering for the C-101 main pedestal foundation.
RMC transit mixers poured 140 m3 of grade M35 concrete for the C-101 main column foundation slab F-101.
Erectors assembled longitudinal steel beams and diagonal cross bracing across Tier 1 of PR-101 pipe rack.
Piping crew performed fit-up and completed root pass TIG welding on the 24-inch crude overhead line spool 24-CDU-002.
Electrical crew torqued busbar joints and checked insulation resistance for 33kV switchgear panels inside Substation 1.
Instrument technicians installed wall-mounted junction box JB-101 in CDU process area and verified gland plate sealing.
Anchor bolts aligned for C-101.
Baseplate levelling done PR-101.
C-101 crane rigging inspection OK.
PR-101 tier 1 pipe supports welded.
PT-1004 stanchion mounted.

Shift Report - Civil & Foundations:
Civil contractor deployed 18 workers and 1 backhoe. Excavation pit for Crude Charge Pump P-101 foundation was completed to target elevation -2.5m. Subgrade was compacted and tested with plate load bearing test. Blind PCC pouring scheduled for tomorrow morning.

Daily Mechanical & Rigging Progress Log:
Heavy lift crew utilized 500T crawler crane to position Hydrotreater Reactor R-201 onto foundation pedestal F-201. Vertical alignment checked using optical total station. Baseplate orientation verified within +/- 1mm tolerance. QC sign-off obtained.

Piping & NDT Progress Summary:
High pressure alloy piping spools (spool ID 12-DHT-001) received at site laydown yard. Visual dimensional inspection and material test certificate (MTC) verification completed by QA engineer. Spools cleared for GTAW root welding.

Electrical Department Shift Summary:
Electrical team welded 120 meters of heavy-duty galvanized ladder cable tray support brackets along PR-101 pipe rack Tier 3 (Grid A1 to A5). Hot-dip galvanizing touch-up paint applied on field welds. QA inspection form signed.
Rebar work ongoing for pump foundation.
Completed cable tray work on main pipe rack.
Impulse tubing installed for pressure transmitter in CDU area.
Pump motor aligned.
Concrete pouring completed for pump foundation.
Piping spool welding completed in process area.
Cable pulling work done by electrical team.
Transmitter calibration completed.
Structural bolt torquing verified.
Site supervisor reported 100% completion of concrete pouring for Column C-101 foundation F-101 (CIV-006), but QC inspector flagged honeycombing on north face requiring repair.
Piping team logged spool 24-CDU-001 erection as complete (PIP-081), however crane breakdown halted final alignment before bolting could be finished.
Mechanical log states Pump P-101A skid (MEC-055) is fully set, but civil team notes anchor bolt grouting has not been poured.
Electrical report marks 11kV cable tray laying (ELE-117) complete for Grid A1-A5, but site inspection revealed missing tray covers from Grid A3 to A5.
Cooling Tower civil basin slab excavation and subgrade compaction completed under CIV-012.
Substation 33kV Switchgear Panel positioning finished inside switchgear room (ELE-114).
